dialogues.speaker: Zhiyao
dialogues.text: Ahoy there and welcome to No. 2, one of The Crux's very finest! It's always a pleasure to play host to the Captain's friends. Make yourself comfortable — mi barco es su barco and all that!

response.speaker: Zhiyao
response.text: Aha, well, technically speaking, she's the second ship of the Alcor class. There are actually many ships much older than her in the fleet.

response.speaker: Zhiyao
response.text: But, to keep things simple and help with organization, the Captain made a rule — all ships are numbered by their tonnage, biggest to smallest.

response.speaker: Zhiyao
response.text: And by that metric, this beauty is comfortably "No. 2." A lot of our boys have been begging to serve aboard her since she joined the fleet.

response.speaker: Zhiyao
response.text: But of course, with great honor comes great responsibility. No. 2 is slated to patrol the most dangerous waters where she's to keep the shipping lanes free from pirates and monsters.

choices.text: I think I'll take a look around.

response.speaker: Zhiyao
response.text: Of course, but try not to take anything apart — no matter how curious you get. And whatever you do, steer clear of anything dangerous. Do not go around hitting any ammo!
